subject: Southridge Health — private deployment kickoff & architecture review
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@southridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Southridge Health — private deployment kickoff & architecture review

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of needs we captured
- Private/VPC deployment behind your network boundary with optional on-prem footprint for PHI processing
- KMS/HSM integration for key management, bring-your-own-key requirement
- VPC peering or Transit Gateway option; requirement for egress control and strict CIDR mapping
- Expected baseline: ~200 QPS inference bursts (p50 latency target 150ms), pilot with ~10 concurrent users, dataset footprint ~500GB (hot+cold)
- Compliance: SOC 2 + audit logs retention 1 year, optional HIPAA BAA

Proposed immediate next step
We recommend a 60-min architecture review (technical deep dive) with your infra/security/IT and our Solutions/CS team to validate network/topology, KMS approach, and orchestration constraints. Suggested slots (all PT):
- Tue May 25, 10:00–11:00
- Tue May 25, 14:00–15:00
- Wed May 26, 09:00–10:00

If none of these work, share 2–3 windows that suit you and your IT lead.

Pre-reads & attendees
- Attached: Southridge_Root_Network_Diagram.png (from our notes) and a short Redwood pre-meeting checklist (redwood-priv-deploy-checklist.pdf).
- From our side: Marcus Lin (Solutions Architect) and Monica Patel (Customer Success) will join. Please include your IT lead and security contact; procurement can also attend if you want to cover contracting cadence.

Open questions for the meeting
1) Do you require all inference to stay on-prem (air-gapped) or is hybrid (private cloud + on-prem connector) acceptable for the pilot?
2) Any strict maintenance windows we must avoid?
3) Preferred KMS vendor (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / on-prem HSM) and any existing HSM vendor details if applicable.

Thanks — if you confirm a slot we’ll send a calendar invite + agenda and a short pre-read doc.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Southridge_Root_Network_Diagram.png (image stub), redwood-priv-deploy-checklist.pdf (doc stub)

From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@southridgehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@southridgehealth.com>, procurement@southridgehealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Southridge Health — private deployment kickoff & architecture review

Thanks Olga — great summary and aligns with what we discussed. Alex (IT lead) and procurement are looped. A few quick notes: 

- We are leaning toward a hybrid model for the pilot: most traffic can be routed through our VPCs, but sensitive PHI inference must be processed on-prem. We can walk the exact split in the deep dive.
- KMS: we run AWS KMS and have an on-prem Thales HSM for tokenization workflows. We’ll want the option to use our KMS for keys in the pilot.
- Maintenance window: weekdays 02:00–04:00 PT is the preferred blackout window.

May 25 at 10:00 PT works for Alex and me. Procurement asked to join the first 15 minutes to confirm contracting timeline. Could you include a short agenda and any network diagram you need us to share?

Emily Turner
Director, Digital Platform
Southridge Health
emily.turner@southridgehealth.com | (617) 555-6789
